selection: One pre-outcome seeded SuiteCRM task from each advanced intent template 3000 through 3019, inherited from the frozen v2 support sample.
constraints: The task list was frozen before v8 actor outcomes.
UGP and HTML/AX use the same task, model, policy, reset, action space, step budget, and scorer.
v8 episodes are never pooled with v2 through v7 adapter outcomes.
This is diagnostic development evidence, not a publication-grade effect estimate.
